names: International Talk Like a Pirate Day

events.text: Battle of Poitiers: the English capture King John II of France.
The Montgolfier brothers fly a sheep, a duck and a rooster in a hot-air balloon at Versailles.
New Zealand becomes the first country to give women the vote in national elections.
The United States carries out the first underground nuclear test, in Nevada.
Scott Fahlman posts the first smiley emoticon :-) on a university message board.
Saint Kitts and Nevis gains independence from the United Kingdom.
A magnitude 8.0 earthquake strikes Mexico City.
Ötzi the Iceman, a 5,300-year-old mummy, is discovered in the Alps.
Another powerful earthquake strikes central Mexico on the same date, 32 years later.
